about_the_game:
Remember the addictive classic "NS-SHAFT / Downstairs Kid / 100 Floors Down if You’re a Man"？

We’ve brought the classic back—now upgraded into a chaotic and hilarious multiplayer party game！

《FallingBattle》is a 2D action party game for 1 to 32 players.

The gameplay is simple yet addictive: keep descending, dodge obstacles, and stay alive！

But don’t think your old tricks will crown you king—this time we’ve added items, troll mechanics, and chaotic interactions.

——Even eliminated players can stir the pot from the sidelines, turning the battlefield into pure mayhem！

Features：

  • 🎉 Up to 32 players online—unlimited madness in every match！

  • 🧨 Tons of items and traps to sabotage friends or turn the tide！

  • 👀 Eliminated? Not useless! Throw chaos into the game with surprise attacks and interference！

  • 😂 A wild and troll-filled atmosphere that guarantees laughs and unexpected moments every round.

  • 🏆 Easy to pick up, hard to master—perfect for parties, streaming, or just watching your friends lose it！

Whether you're a platforming pro, party game fanatic, or just here to watch your friends fail, this game is sure to make you laugh out loud.

Ready to descend with your friends... and fall into total madness?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10, 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti or AMD RX 550, 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10, 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580, 4GB VRAM or Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
